question: How do I browse upcoming Lumenloop events rather than keyword-search them?

golden.answer: Use `lumenloop.list_documents({collection: 'events', period: 'upcoming'})`. The observed result returned document summaries and pagination. Use `search_documents` only when you know exact title/URL wording; its substring search is not conceptual search.
keyFacts: Uses `list_documents` plus the `period` argument for upcoming-event browsing.
Treats browsing and exact title/URL substring lookup as different actions.
avoid: Do NOT pass the nonexistent `time_period` argument or claim exact search covers document body meaning.
golden.notes: N1 live contract probe 2026-07-11: Succeeded with period=upcoming and two event summaries plus pagination; an invalid `time_period` argument was rejected before any call.
